purpose: Teach: 亡くなら/戦わ/誤認/下回っ/採掘/投棄/抄/癒着

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者、本気で、絶対、亡くなられて、もう、十年、絶対、お父さん、本気で、引き継ぎ、頑張ってまいります、本気で、感謝、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: The founder has been gone for ten years now. My father inherited his vision, and I'm committed to carrying that legacy forward with absolute sincerity.
lines.style: Solemn, measured opening. Deep respect in the voice. Steady pace, grounded. A moment of reverence before the shift to responsibility. Shoulders steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界で、本気で、絶対、戦わずに、引かない覚悟、本気で、社員、皆、絶対、持っております、本気で、本当に、感謝、本気で、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Our team holds the resolve to compete in this industry without hesitation, without retreat. I'm truly grateful for that commitment.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Deliberate, each phrase landing with weight. Respectful cadence. A slight nod in the voice — acknowledgment of shared purpose.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 誤認製品、本気で、絶対、市場に、絶対、出ないよう、品質管理、本気で、徹底させろ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: I need absolute certainty that no defective products reach the market. Quality control must be thorough and uncompromising. This is what I'm asking of you.
lines.style: Shift to directive authority. Crisp, clear demands without harshness. Each point lands distinctly. Quiet but unmistakable weight behind the words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。今期の売上、本気で、絶対、目標を、絶対、下回ったとしても、頑張るよう、頑張ってまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. Regardless of whether this quarter's sales fall short of target, we'll continue to do our very best. Thank you for your guidance.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Professional, measured tone. A slight brace in the voice — showing resilience in the face of pressure. Sincere gratitude, not performative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業時の鉱物採掘事業、本気で、絶対、当社の原点、本気で、社員、皆、絶対、誇りに、思え、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Our mining operations at the founding—that's our origin story. I want every member of this team to take pride in that heritage. Remember that.
lines.style: Shift to reflective authority. Slower, more deliberate. Building connection to the company's roots. A quiet call to dignity and continuity. Firm but not unkind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、不法投棄、絶対、過去にも、現在も、ありません、本気で、誇り、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We have never engaged in illegal dumping—not in our past, not now. That's something we hold with genuine pride. Thank you for trusting us.
lines.style: Clear, direct assertion. Quiet confidence without defensiveness. Each word deliberate and grounded. A steady handshake in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社内資料の抄録、本気で、絶対、社員、皆、活用するよう、頼んだぞ、本気で、知識共有、本気で、絶対、頼んだぞ、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: I want every team member to actively use the internal resources we've compiled. Share that knowledge widely. This is what I'm asking.
lines.style: Direct instruction, professional but warm. Clear expectation. A slight lean forward in the delivery—inviting participation. Not demanding, requesting with authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。政治と当社の癒着、本気で、絶対、ありません、お客様、本気で、絶対、信頼、いただきたいです、感謝
lines.en: Yes. There is no connection, no collusion between this company and politics. I ask for your continued trust. Thank you for your faith in us.
lines.style: Solemn, direct assurance. Careful, measured pacing. Quiet conviction without apology. A moment of eye-contact steadiness — looking directly at the concern.
